attributes.name: Gilbrok the Tongue
attributes.powers:
If the check to defeat does not have the Swashbuckling trait, subtract 1 from each die rolled. 

If undefeated, roll 1d6. On 1-3, summon and encounter the henchman Eye of Dagon; on 4-6, summon and encounter the henchman Breath of Dagon. If the summoned henchman is undefeated, display it next to your character card.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.

corrections.corrected_text: On the henchman Gilbrok the Tongue, add the following to the end of the second power: “If the summoned henchman is undefeated, display it next to your character card.”
corrections.issue: When you resolve an encounter with a summoned card, it's always supposed to go back in the box unless the card that summons it tells you otherwise. But Gilbrok the Tongue summons a henchman that seems like it’s supposed to stick around if undefeated, but Gilbrok doesn't actually tell you otherwise. What happens?
